narrative.overview: A restrained operational system derived from nature reserve survey sheets. Pine navigation separates wayfinding from a pale working surface; compact typography and ruled data tables support frequent administration. The influence supplies palette, type, density, and one lifecycle signature—not a paper or game-interface costume.
keyCharacteristics: Dense, legible tables and native controls.
Flat working surfaces with explicit action hierarchy.
Readiness based on observations, not optimistic animation.

rules.name: The Observed State Rule
rules.body: Unknown observations stay unknown. Green does not mean a request was merely accepted.

dos: Do keep operational state, safety warnings, and contextual actions easy to scan.
Do preserve labels, focus visibility, error details, and useful empty states.
Do use standard web layouts and controls across all workflows.
Do distinguish accepted work from completed work.
donts: Don't add fake metrics, optimistic successful operations, or invented player metadata.
Don't nest generic cards to manufacture hierarchy.
Don't turn paths and identifiers into decorative technical typography.
Don't load remote fonts, proprietary art, or generated imagery for routine administration.
